    with open(DATA_PATH) as f:

    return {p["id"]: p for p in data}

    with open(path) as f:
        data = json.load(f)
    ppi = data["per_problem_ii"]
    level = list(ppi.keys())[0]
    return ppi[level], data

    parts = problem_id.split("/")
    if len(parts) >= 2:
        return parts[1]
    return "unknown"
